frequency_question: How often does the Department of Education terminate an accreditor's status rather than renewing or extending it within the review window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal departmental review of a primary national accrediting body for a major profession (law, medicine, nursing, engineering, etc.) where renewal or revocation was explicitly decided. Excludes minor procedural deferrals without final status determination.

coverage_note: 7 named major professional accreditor review processes with high-stakes compliance disputes; believed to capture all comparable high-salience federal challenges in the modern administrative era.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier institutional accreditors of small vocational schools, focusing primarily on dominant professional-field accreditors.
validity_reason: Administrative review standards and statutory criteria for recognizing accreditors remain stable across multiple presidential administrations, changing slowly through statutory reauthorizations.
